flows: A customer picks a stylist and a time slot, enters a name and phone number, and pays a deposit through Paystack to hold the booking.
After payment the customer sees a booking confirmation page and receives an SMS reminder.
The owner opens the admin page, signs in with a shared password and sees all bookings for the week.
dataCollected: Customer name, phone number and email address, stored with each booking.
Paystack payment reference and amount for each deposit.
payments: A fixed deposit is charged through Paystack when a booking is made. The remaining balance is paid in the salon.
Refunds are not handled in the app.
roles: Customer: books and pays a deposit without creating an account.
Admin: one shared login for the owner and staff, who can see and cancel every booking.

questions: Anyone with the booking link can see the customer's name and phone number. Is that meant?
A booking is confirmed on the page before the payment result is checked. Should a declined deposit release the slot?
The admin page uses one shared password. Do staff need separate logins?

findings.title: Booking shows as confirmed before the deposit is checked
findings.plain: The customer sees Booking confirmed as soon as they return from Paystack, even if the payment was declined or abandoned.
findings.costIfIgnored: Slots are held for people who never paid, and real customers find the time already taken.
findings.fixPrompt: In the booking route, mark a booking as confirmed only after the Paystack payment is verified on the server. Release the slot if verification fails.

findings.title: Admin page has one shared password with no lockout
findings.plain: Anyone who guesses the single admin password can see every customer's name and phone number and cancel bookings.
findings.costIfIgnored: Customer details can leak and bookings can be cancelled by a stranger.
findings.fixPrompt: Add a limit on failed admin sign-in attempts and give each staff member their own login.
